brief.meaningEn: Impressive presentation or publicity outweighs genuine practical value.
brief.meaningZh: 表面聲勢或宣傳大於真正的實際價值。
brief.grammar: More show than substance; compare visible display with what the event or proposal actually delivers.
brief.register: Critical but natural commentary. A community organiser may use it when a launch event is lavish but promised services do not appear.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有外在展示與實際成果的對照；單純設計漂亮、但同時提供有用服務，不足以批評為華而不實。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不表示完全沒有任何價值，也不是反對所有慶祝或設計。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出宣傳或場面，以及缺乏的具體實際成果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 79, row 14; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The costly event felt more show than substance.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.en: A costly health fair had banners, cameras and a long opening speech, but no appointment desk or written guidance for visitors. Several people left without knowing where to seek help. It felt more show than substance.
listening.zh: 昂貴健康展有橫幅、鏡頭及冗長開幕演說，卻沒有預約櫃檯或給訪客的書面指引。多人離開時仍不知去哪裏求助。活動顯得外表風光多於實質。

options.en: The polished launch did not provide the practical help visitors needed.
options.zh: 漂亮的開幕沒有提供訪客需要的實際協助。

options.en: The fair had no visual material of any kind.
options.zh: 展會完全沒有任何視覺材料。

options.en: The appointment desk gave detailed help to everyone.
options.zh: 預約櫃檯為所有人提供詳細協助。

options.en: The fair was cancelled before visitors arrived.
options.zh: 訪客到來前展會已取消。

listening.explanationZh: 外在聲勢與實際服務不相稱。

reply.promptEn: A new study app launches with celebrity videos and glossy ads, but the promised practice questions are missing and users cannot save answers. What might a student say?
reply.promptZh: （新學習程式以明星影片和精美廣告推出，但承諾的練習題缺失，用戶也不能儲存答案。學生可怎樣說？）

options.en: The publicity is stronger than the learning tools.
options.zh: 宣傳比學習工具強。

options.en: The missing questions matter more than the videos.
options.zh: 缺失練習題比影片更重要。

options.en: It looks more show than substance.
options.zh: 它看來外表風光多於實質。

options.en: The attractive launch does not deliver the promised practice.
options.zh: 吸引的推出活動沒有提供承諾的練習。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均比較展示與實際功能。

scene.promptZh: 社區計劃舉行華麗記者會，卻仍沒有開通承諾的輔導熱線。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The launch is more show than substance.
options.zh: 推出活動外表風光多於實質。

options.en: The hotline is already helping every resident.
options.zh: 熱線已協助每位居民。

options.en: Any attractive design makes a service useless.
options.zh: 任何好看設計都令服務無用。

scene.explanationZh: 宣傳先行而核心服務未到位。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 more show than substance？

options.en: A modestly designed service quietly delivers the promised appointments and clear guidance to users.
options.zh: 設計樸素的服務默默提供承諾的預約及清楚指引。

options.en: A polished programme advertises lessons that are not yet available.
options.zh: 精美計劃宣傳尚未開辦的課。

options.en: A large launch ceremony offers no way to access the announced support.
options.zh: 盛大開幕禮卻沒有取得所宣布支援的方法。

contrast.explanationZh: 實際成果到位且沒有空洞宣傳。

dialogue.promptEn: A: The new reading centre has a dramatic launch video, but the books are not catalogued and visitors cannot borrow any yet. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：新閱讀中心有震撼開幕影片，但書籍尚未編目，訪客也未能借閱。乙：______）

options.en: The launch display is ahead of the service.
options.zh: 開幕展示走在服務前面。

options.en: Borrowing matters more than the video for readers.
options.zh: 對讀者而言借書比影片重要。

options.en: At the moment, it seems more show than substance.
options.zh: 目前看來外表風光多於實質。

options.en: Cataloguing the books would give the centre practical value.
options.zh: 為書編目才能讓中心有實際價值。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指當前展示超過可用服務。

speaking.en: The park project’s illuminated model impressed visitors, but with no confirmed accessible path in the actual plan it risked becoming more show than substance.
speaking.zh: 公園工程的發光模型令訪客印象深刻，但實際計劃尚未確認無障礙路線，恐怕外表風光多於實質。
speaking.promptZh: 比較模型展示與實際缺口。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩項產品或計劃各有醒目的宣傳，但承諾的核心效用不足。用英文寫出展示與缺失。
writing.selfCheckZh: 不能只因作品漂亮就批評；兩例須指出未交付的實際價值。

examples.en: The language course was more show than substance: its launch had bright screens and prizes, while learners still lacked the promised feedback sessions.
examples.zh: 語言課程外表風光多於實質：開幕有亮麗螢幕和獎品，學員卻仍沒有承諾的回饋課。

examples.en: A glossy neighbourhood guide felt more show than substance because it displayed striking photos but omitted bus access and opening hours visitors needed.
examples.zh: 精美鄰里指南有奪目照片，卻漏掉訪客需要的巴士路線與開放時間，顯得外表風光多於實質。

takeaways.en: More show than substance contrasts display with actual value.
takeaways.zh: more show than substance 對比外在展示與實際價值。

takeaways.en: A beautiful launch is more show than substance if the promised help is missing.
takeaways.zh: 若承諾的協助缺失，漂亮開幕便可能華而不實。

brief.meaningEn: Attract the most prominent news attention, often overshadowing other stories.
brief.meaningZh: 吸引最顯眼的新聞注意，常令其他消息被遮蓋。
brief.grammar: Grab the headlines; subject is a story, event or person. Distinct from simply make headlines: this sense highlights attention dominance.
brief.register: Neutral to slightly vivid news commentary. An editor may use it when one story takes the lead position ahead of other reported matters.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有顯著的新聞焦點或壓過其他報道的線索；只在地方通訊中被提及一次，不足以說搶佔頭條。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是用手抓報紙，也不表示該故事最重要或最可靠。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出顯眼報道、被遮蓋的其他消息及新聞注意與重要性未必相同。

listening.en: A celebrity’s surprise wedding led every evening news page, while a new flood-warning map received only a short item. The wedding grabbed the headlines, though the map mattered more to some residents.
listening.zh: 明星突然結婚佔據各晚間新聞版面頭位，新的洪水警告地圖卻只得到短訊。婚禮搶佔新聞焦點，雖然地圖對部分居民更重要。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼顯示婚禮 grabs the headlines？

options.en: It took the prominent lead position across news pages.
options.zh: 它佔據多個新聞版面的顯眼頭位。

options.en: It was mentioned once in a private message.
options.zh: 它只在私人訊息被提及一次。

options.en: The flood map received more prominent coverage everywhere.
options.zh: 洪水地圖在各處得到更顯眼報道。

options.en: The wedding was necessarily more important to every resident.
options.zh: 婚禮對每名居民必然更重要。

listening.explanationZh: 頭位報道表示焦點，不等於普遍重要。

reply.promptEn: Several papers lead with a singer’s award, while a local housing consultation appears below in brief. A reader notices that one story dominates the page. What can the reader say?
reply.promptZh: （數份報紙都以歌手獲獎作頭條，地方住屋諮詢只在下方短訊出現。讀者注意到一則消息主導版面。可怎樣說？）

options.en: The award receives the most prominent placement.
options.zh: 獎項得到最顯眼的位置。

options.en: The housing item gets far less space.
options.zh: 住屋消息所佔位置小得多。

options.en: The award grabs the headlines.
options.zh: 獎項搶佔新聞焦點。

options.en: Prominence does not settle which issue matters more.
options.zh: 顯眼程度不能決定哪件事更重要。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據版面顯眼程度。

scene.promptZh: 大部分新聞首頁都把一場體育決賽列最前，另一項重要交通通知只佔角落。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The final grabs the headlines.
options.zh: 決賽搶佔新聞焦點。

options.en: The final was mentioned only in a footnote.
options.zh: 決賽只在註腳出現。

options.en: The final must matter more than transport to every reader.
options.zh: 決賽對每名讀者必定比交通重要。

scene.explanationZh: 佔據版面顯眼位置是焦點，不是重要性判斷。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以說 a story grabs the headlines？

options.en: An item appears once in a small notice and does not lead or dominate any news coverage.
options.zh: 一項消息只在小告示出現一次，沒有引領或主導新聞報道。

options.en: A result appears at the top of many news pages and pushes other stories down.
options.zh: 一項結果佔多個新聞版面最前，其他消息被擠到下面。

options.en: A surprise announcement becomes the lead story across major outlets.
options.zh: 突然公布的消息成為多家主要媒體頭條。

contrast.explanationZh: 小角落提及沒有主導注意。

dialogue.promptEn: A: Today’s front pages lead with the actor’s award, while the new safety notice is tucked inside. B: ______
dialogue.promptZh: （甲：今天各報頭版以演員獲獎作頭條，新安全通知則藏在內頁。乙：______）

options.en: The award has the most visible placement.
options.zh: 獎項佔最顯眼位置。

options.en: The safety notice may still matter more to some readers.
options.zh: 安全通知對部分讀者仍可能更重要。

options.en: The award grabs the headlines.
options.zh: 獎項搶佔新聞焦點。

options.en: Front-page attention and practical importance can differ.
options.zh: 頭版關注與實際重要性可不同。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出媒體焦點及其局限。

speaking.en: The visiting chef’s new restaurant grabbed the headlines across town, while a quieter report on library hours appeared only inside the papers.
speaking.zh: 來訪廚師的新餐廳搶佔全城新聞焦點，圖書館開放時間的較平靜報道則只在內頁。
speaking.promptZh: 對比顯眼報道與被壓低的消息。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩則新聞各佔顯眼位置，另一項仍值得留意的消息被較少報道。用英文寫出焦點與對比。
writing.selfCheckZh: 不能只說消息有被報道；須指出主導版面的證據。

examples.en: The new stadium design grabbed the headlines on several local sites, while changes to bus access appeared in small follow-up notes.
examples.zh: 新球場設計搶佔多個地方網站頭條，巴士通道改動則只在小型跟進訊息出現。

examples.en: When the school robot won a prize, it grabbed the headlines in community papers, leaving the updated meal policy on an inside page.
examples.zh: 學校機械人獲獎時搶佔社區報紙焦點，更新後的膳食政策只在內頁。

takeaways.en: Grab the headlines means dominate prominent news attention.
takeaways.zh: grab the headlines 指主導顯眼新聞關注。

takeaways.en: A story that grabs the headlines is not automatically the most important.
takeaways.zh: 搶佔新聞焦點的故事未必最重要。
